name: Ej, uchnem!
pages: Wikimedia Commons, "Ej, uchnem!.mid" (setting by Peter Gerloff, CC0)
about: The song of the Volga barge haulers, first printed by Mily Balakirev in 1866: the setting's call and answer in two octaves, here as one line, the rests between phrases held over. Moved up an octave.
